
#[tokio::test(flavor = "current_thread")]
async fn dtp_name_semantic_control() {
    for count in [32usize, 256] {
        for lexical in [false, true] {
            for success in [false, true] {
                let (mut admin, listener) = admin_and_listener().await;
                let names: Vec<String> = (0..count).map(|n| format!("topic-{n}")).collect();
                let peer_names = names.clone();
                let peer = tokio::spawn(async move {
                    let (mut socket, _) = listener.accept().await.unwrap();
                    socket.set_nodelay(true).unwrap();
                    let (header, mut body) = request(&mut socket).await;
                    assert_eq!((header.api_key, header.api_version), (DESCRIBE_TOPIC_PARTITIONS, 0));
                    let (requested, limit, cursor) = decode_describe_topic_partitions_request(&mut body).unwrap();
                    assert_eq!(requested, peer_names);
                    assert_eq!(limit, if success { i32::try_from(count).unwrap() } else { 1 });
                    assert!(cursor.is_none());
                    assert!(body.is_empty());
                    let mut topics: Vec<_> = peer_names.iter().map(|name| {
                        let error = if success { 0 } else { crate::error::UNKNOWN_TOPIC_OR_PARTITION };
                        let mut topic = DescribedTopicPartitions::new(name.as_str(), error);
                        if success {
                            let mut partition = DescribedTopicPartition::new(0);
                            partition.leader_id = 1;
                            topic.partitions.push(partition);
                        }
                        topic
                    }).collect();
                    if lexical {
                        topics.sort_by(|left, right| left.name.cmp(&right.name));
                    }
                    send_page(&mut socket, &header, &DescribeTopicPartitionsResponse::new(topics)).await.unwrap();
                });
                let limit = if success { i32::try_from(count).unwrap() } else { 1 };
                let got = admin.describe_topics_with_partition_limit_timeout(
                    names.iter(), false, limit, Duration::from_secs(5),
                ).await.unwrap();
                let mut expected = names.clone();
                if lexical {
                    expected.sort();
                }
                assert_eq!(got.len(), expected.len());
                for (row, name) in got.iter().zip(expected.iter()) {
                    assert_eq!(&row.name, name);
                    assert_eq!(row.topic_id, [0; 16]);
                    assert!(!row.is_internal);
                    assert_eq!(row.error_code, if success { 0 } else { crate::error::UNKNOWN_TOPIC_OR_PARTITION });
                    assert_eq!(row.authorized_operations, AUTHORIZED_OPERATIONS_OMITTED);
                    assert_eq!(row.partitions.len(), if success { 1 } else { 0 });
                    if success {
                        assert_eq!(row.partitions[0].topic, *name);
                        assert_eq!(row.partitions[0].partition, 0);
                        assert_eq!(row.partitions[0].leader, 1);
                    }
                }
                peer.await.unwrap();
            }
        }
    }
}
